title: Expert choice leaves a token out
notes: Two slots per expert. E2 likes things and there are none, so it takes the two ands. E4 takes the first two thes, and no expert takes the third: it passes by on the residual. E3 takes dog over cat, 0.154 to 0.146. Expert choice balances the experts, not the tokens.
ops: the cat and the dog and the fox
